tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background and the default ground for everything.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines, dividers, and the fill of disabled controls and neutral tags. Decorative only; not for borders that carry meaning (use ink or ink-muted).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and headlines on paper (17.9:1), leaf-soft (14.8:1), highlight (16.3:1) and leaf (5.8:1). Also the bold block colour and the focus ring.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions and metadata on paper (6.9:1), leaf-soft (5.7:1) and highlight (6.3:1). Also input borders on paper.

tokens.name: paper-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and metadata on ink blocks (8.4:1).

tokens.name: leaf
tokens.usage: The brand green (Grass): primary buttons, big colour blocks, and icons or borders that carry meaning on paper (3.1:1). Not for text on paper; use leaf-ink. On ink it works as text or marks (5.8:1).

tokens.name: on-leaf
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a leaf fill (5.8:1).

tokens.name: leaf-ink
tokens.usage: Green as text: links and positive values on paper (5.6:1), leaf-soft (4.6:1) and highlight (5.1:1).

tokens.name: leaf-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted panels, selected rows and tag backgrounds behind ink or leaf-ink text.

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: Pale marker yellow, always behind ink text (16.3:1): a marker stroke under a word or two (rb-mark), the leading row of a table, a sticker (rb-sticker, ink ring). Never text, and never a bare block on paper (1.1:1, it disappears). One per screen.

tokens.name: alert
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions; as text on paper (5.0:1). Always paired with a word or icon. Orange so it never relies on a green/red difference.

tokens.name: alert-soft
tokens.usage: Background of error alerts, behind ink text (15.7:1). The alert icon on it is 4.4:1.

tokens.name: team-1
tokens.usage: Team 1 (navy): team badges, bars and dots. Text on it is on-team-1. Always shown with the team's initial or name, never colour alone.

tokens.name: on-team-1
tokens.usage: Text and initials on team-1 (9.4:1).

tokens.name: team-2
tokens.usage: Team 2 (sky): team badges, bars and dots. Light, so badges keep their 2px ink ring on paper (2.2:1 without it).

tokens.name: on-team-2
tokens.usage: Text and initials on team-2 (8.0:1).

tokens.name: team-3
tokens.usage: Team 3 (orange): team badges, bars and dots. Light, so badges keep their 2px ink ring on paper (2.2:1 without it). Not an error colour: errors use alert plus an icon.

tokens.name: on-team-3
tokens.usage: Text and initials on team-3 (8.2:1).

tokens.name: team-4
tokens.usage: Team 4 (magenta): team badges, bars and dots. Text on it is on-team-4.

tokens.name: on-team-4
tokens.usage: Text and initials on team-4 (5.4:1).

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, tags and eyebrows, set in capitals.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps, tight inline spacing.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside controls and between related items.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Control padding, card padding on small screens, stack gaps.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Card padding, section gutters and the gap between sections.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, tags, small chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, colour blocks.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons and toggles: always fully round.
